name: marketing
description: Short-video marketing: an orchestrator (run) plus self-contained workers with structured JSON input and output: culto interview, reference analysis, case questions, angle, offer, script, and critique.

interface.longDescription: Analyze why a reference video worked, ask for a concrete case, choose an angle, write the script beat by beat, and critique it with the expert's criteria. Every skill takes and returns JSON under the marketing/v1 contract.
defaultPrompt: Explain why this reference video worked.
Ask me questions that get a concrete story for my next video.
Turn this case into video angles.
Write a 30 second script from this angle.
Critique this script with the expert's criteria.
